summary: The recipe turns a plausible repair into a causal, reviewable claim by preserving the same failing observation across the patch boundary.

points.text: Unit-test guidance emphasizes isolated, repeatable and self-checking tests that protect against regression; those properties make the reproducer a durable defect contract.
Running the new regression test against the unpatched baseline guards against a common false proof: a test that passes both before and after the change.
Keeping the patch small is not aesthetic minimalism; it narrows the causal explanation and the regression surface a reviewer must evaluate.
